Grade A bots

__COUNT__ of the community bots pass the static risk audit: the stake does not grow after a loss (no martingale or other progression) and the bot has a session loss limit, so it stops by itself. Click a name to download the XML, then import it in Deriv Bot.

Grade A is not a promise of profit. It only means the money management is not built to blow up. No strategy beats the house edge on synthetic indices. The audit is a heuristic reading of the XML, so check the blocks yourself and run every bot on a demo account first.
